#!/bin/bash
LOCAL=http://localhost:8888
REMOTE=http://192.168.0.86:8888
for BANK in "coding-agent::Simipix" "coding-agent::user" "coding-agent::sigil-of-the-unwilling" "pi-global" "coding-agent::pi-memtest3"; do
  echo "=== $BANK ==="
  OP=$(curl -s -m 30 -X POST "$LOCAL/v1/default/banks/$BANK/document-transfer/export" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{}' | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['operation_id'])")
  # poll export
  for i in $(seq 1 60); do
    R=$(curl -s -m 10 "$LOCAL/v1/default/banks/$BANK/operations/$OP")
    S=$(echo "$R" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['status'])")
    [ "$S" = "completed" ] && break
    [ "$S" = "failed" ] && { echo "EXPORT FAILED: $R"; break 2; }
    sleep 2
  done
  URL=$(echo "$R" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['result_metadata']['download_url'])")
  curl -s -m 60 -o "transfer-$(echo $BANK | tr '/:' '__').zip" "$LOCAL$URL"
  ZIP="transfer-$(echo $BANK | tr '/:' '__').zip"
  echo "  exported: $(wc -c < $ZIP) bytes"
  IOP=$(curl -s -m 60 -X POST "$REMOTE/v1/default/banks/$BANK/document-transfer" -F "file=@$ZIP" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['operation_id'])")
  for i in $(seq 1 120); do
    R=$(curl -s -m 10 "$REMOTE/v1/default/banks/$BANK/operations/$IOP")
    S=$(echo "$R" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['status'])")
    [ "$S" = "completed" ] && break
    [ "$S" = "failed" ] && { echo "IMPORT FAILED: $R"; break 2; }
    sleep 2
  done
  echo "  import result: $(echo "$R" | python3 -c "import json,sys; m=json.load(sys.stdin)['result_metadata']; print('facts:',m['facts_imported'],'docs:',m['documents_imported'],'obs:',m['observations_imported'],'skipped:',m['documents_skipped'])")"
done
echo "=== DONE ==="
EOF
chmod +x migrate.sh && ./migrate.sh
